channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Expect even more homebuying assistance competition after fed rule
item.description: House hunters in need of down payment or closing cost funds have options, but they’ll need to apply early in the year to secure financial help.

item.title: Napheesa Collier expected to miss 4-6 months after ankle surgery
item.description: The Lynx star will not be able to play for her Unrivaled team this season and might be out at the start of the 2026 WNBA season.

item.title: These events are reinventing the singles mixer for younger daters
item.description: As dating app fatigue rises, people looking for love in the Twin Cities seek out new ways to connect in person.

item.title: Weighing retirement, Vikings fullback C.J. Ham plans to enjoy a ‘special’ season finale
item.description: The Duluth native will have about 30 friends and family members at U.S. Bank Stadium for the Packers game because he knows it could be his last in the NFL.

item.title: Souhan: Looking back at my favorite Minnesota sports figures of 2025 as a new year begins
item.description: Humor, honesty, decency and class are hallmarks of these athletes, coaches and broadcasters who left an impression last year.

item.title: Xcel Energy gas rates will go up 6.8% for 2026. Here’s why.
item.description: Minnesota utility regulators approved temporarily higher rates but said they are sensitive to higher energy bills.

item.title: Brooks: Fraud allegations are latest work of right-wing influencers descending on Minnesota in search of scandal
item.description: Feds deploy to Minnesota in response to Nick Shirley’s YouTube video alleging day care fraud.

item.title: Magic number is 53 for Vikings receiver Justin Jefferson vs. the Packers
item.description: Jefferson’s personal goal is a sixth consecutive 1,000-yard season. He seems likely to be catching passes from J.J. McCarthy to try to get it in the season finale.

item.title: We went to the day cares Nick Shirley did. Here’s what we found.
item.description: Some of the 10 day cares the YouTube content creator blasted for having “no children” invited reporters in to see for themselves.

item.title: He was ridiculed in the U.S. Now he’s a celebrity in China.
item.description: How Evan Kail, a St. Louis Park rare-coin dealer, became an unexpected public figure on the other side of the world.
